text:
Priya: Heads-up 1: we need a concise GA gating smoke that covers SLA wording sanity, docs + runbook, oncall thresholds, monitoring alerts, and a quick pricing/billing check. Owners by area pls. Need final ack by EOD.

Marco: I can take pricing/billing. Plan: run a short tokenized load + verify billing record tags show X-Cost-Tag and per-token counts align. Will do a 10m job at 14:00 UTC.

Dana: I'll own monitoring and alerts. Quick checklist:
- synthetic traffic 5-15 qps for 10m
- ensure p95 latency < 350ms for small payloads
- alerts: >5% 5xx in 5m, >15% token rejection rate
- smoke dashboard panel + runbook link in alert payload

Chris: I'll take docs & support handback. I'll draft a 1-page TL;DR + exact curl samples + rollback steps. Need sample error messages from Marco/Dana to copy verbatim.

Priya: Great. Owners: Marco -> pricing, Dana -> monitoring/oncall, Chris -> docs/support. I'll update the SLA blurb (keep customer-facing metric + exceptions) and loop legal if wording changes. @Marco @Dana @Chris drop a quick ack when you start.

CI-Bot: Created ticket PROJ-2021 "GA smokeflow & owner handback" assigned to Priya, Marco, Dana, Chris. Due EOD.

Marco: Ack. Pricing smoke commands I'll run: 
```
# run from k8s job
loadgen --qps 12 --duration 10m --payload 128 --route /v1/predict
billing-audit --window 15m --filter X-Cost-Tag=ga-smokeflow
```
I'll attach CSV of tokens and meterIDs to the ticket. Expectation: no >20% spike in per-token billed amounts.

Dana: Ack. Oncall snippet for runbook I'll add:
```
if rate(5xx, 5m) > 5% then escalate SRE-oncall
if token_rejects(10m) > 10% then page model-owner
fallback: route -> quantized-small for 8m then monitor
```
Also will enable a temporary webhook that includes runbook URL in alerts.

Chris: Ack. Drafting support handoff doc now. Curl examples I'll include:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "X-Cost-Tag: ga-smokeflow" -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
```
Pls paste two canonical error strings (exact text) so I capture them.

Marco: two likely errors: "model_kv_overflow" and "quota_exceeded_token_limit" 1. Pushing exact logs into PROJ-2021. Also note: finance wants header X-Cost-Tag spelled out in docs.

Dana: Running burnin at 14:00 UTC now. I'll post metrics snapshot. If auto-fallback hits we'll annotate timeline in ticket.

(14:12) Dana: Burnin done 1. p95 stayed ~280ms except one 30s blip at 14:05. Auto-fallback triggered and recovered. I attached the grafana snapshot.

(14:25) Marco: Pricing run complete. Billing records show X-Cost-Tag present and token counts match loadgen CSV. No unexpected per-token CPI increase. CSV uploaded to PROJ-2021.

Chris: Updated the runbook with TL;DR, curl snippets, the two error strings, and a short rollback sequence. Link: internal://docs/runbooks/ga-smokeflow.md (placeholder).

Priya: Excellent. Final step: add a single-line closure ack when your area is done; I'll assemble a short handback note to sales/support with the runbook link + SLA note.

Marco: DONE :thumbsup:

Dana: DONE :thumbsup: (noted blip and documented mitigation)

Chris: DONE :thumbsup: (docs and checklist committed)

Priya: Thanks all. I'll send the handoff email in 10m and close PROJ-2021.
